verses.ar: لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. مَزْمُورُ تَسْبِيحَةٍ أَسَاسُهُ فِي ٱلْجِبَالِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةِ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm [or] Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation [is] in the holy mountains.
verses.web: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ أَحَبَّ أَبْوَابَ صِهْيَوْنَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.web: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.ar: قَدْ قِيلَ بِكِ أَمْجَادٌ يَا مَدِينَةَ ٱللهِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.web: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

verses.ar: «أَذْكُرُ رَهَبَ وَبَابِلَ عَارِفَتَيَّ. هُوَذَا فَلَسْطِينُ وَصُورُ مَعَ كُوشَ. هَذَا وُلِدَ هُنَاكَ».
verses.kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this [man] was born there.
verses.web: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

verses.ar: وَلِصِهْيَوْنَ يُقَالُ: «هَذَا ٱلْإِنْسَانُ، وَهَذَا ٱلْإِنْسَانُ وُلِدَ فِيهَا، وَهِيَ ٱلْعَلِيُّ يُثَبِّتُهَا».
verses.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَعُدُّ فِي كِتَابَةِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ: «أَنَّ هَذَا وُلِدَ هُنَاكَ». سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, [that] this [man] was born there. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

verses.kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments [shall be there:] all my springs [are] in thee.
verses.web: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
